Her fingers fly across a specialized diagnostic interface, pulling up high-resolution thermal and strain mapping of Beta-9. "It’s forcing us to perform our own structural vulnerability," she concludes, the severity in her voice absolute. "We need to stabilize Beta-9 before that breach reaches the life support grid—and we need Riona Thorne for a manual seal."

The solution requires the very person Helena warned you about, pulled from the contaminated Node Three zone. The structural integrity of the station is now defined by Riona’s willingness to step into a burning junction point.
